integrity: Convex-order monotonicity follows directly from strict convexity of the Euler–Lotka kernel and monotonicity of its root. The adjacent and endpoint laws are proved to be the exact convex-order extremizers on an integer age interval. An independent exact-rational replay checks tens of thousands of finite distributions and the worked polynomial example.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to strict integer age classes, a fixed finite reproductive-age window, fixed net reproductive rate and fixed mean reproductive age. It does not cover stochastic environments, density dependence, uncertain vital rates, or irreducible stage structure.
title: Integer reproductive ages have sharp adjacent-to-endpoint Euler–Lotka growth bounds
